mapper.update: UPDATE srv_inspection_rule_revision SET inspection_item = #{command.inspectionItem}, description = #{command.description}, category_code = #{command.categoryCode}, category_name_snapshot = #{command.categoryNameSnapshot}, severity_code = #{command.severityCode}, severity_name_snapshot = #{command.severityNameSnapshot}, sort_order = #{command.sortOrder}, expected_result_regex = #{command.expectedResultRegex}, threshold_data_type = #{command.thresholdDataType}, threshold_operator = #{command.thresholdOperator}, threshold_value = #{command.thresholdValue}, threshold_unit = #{command.thresholdUnit}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{command.tenantId} AND id = #{command.revisionId} AND status_code = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{command.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE srv_inspection_rule_revision SET status_code = 'PUBLISHED', category_name_snapshot = #{command.categoryNameSnapshot}, severity_name_snapshot = #{command.severityNameSnapshot}, published_by = #{command.publishedBy}, published_at = #{command.publishedAt}, disabled_by = NULL, disabled_at = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{command.tenantId} AND id = #{command.revisionId} AND status_code = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{command.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS rule_id, i.version AS rule_version, target.id AS target_revision_id, target.version AS target_revision_version, target.status_code AS target_revision_status_code, published.id AS current_published_revision_id, published.revision_no AS current_published_revision_no, published.version AS current_published_revision_version FROM srv_inspection_rule i JOIN srv_inspection_rule_revision target ON target.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND target.rule_id = i.id AND target.id = #{query.targetRevisionId} AND target.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN srv_inspection_rule_revision published ON published.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND published.rule_id = i.id AND published.status_code = 'PUBLISHED' AND published.deleted = b'0' WHERE i.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND i.id = #{query.ruleId} AND i.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
